items.headline: Gravity Fitness Signs 23K-SF Lease at Queens’ Flushing Plaza

Muss Development did not disclose the length of the lease, but the asking rent for the building was $52 per square foot.…

The Florida-based bank signed a retail lease for 10,068 square feet on the south corner of Amazon ’s tower at 452 Fifth Avenue , also known as 10 Bryant Park . The retailer formerly known as Burlington Coat Factory signed a 31,717-square-foot retail lease at 25 Navy Street , according to city records filed Tuesday evening. The vacant two-story development between Sands Street and Flushing Avenue borders the Wegmans -anchored shopping center at Admiral’s Row , an 8-acre mixed-use campus developed by Doug Steiner ’s development arm, Steiner NYC .…

items.headline: Chinese Restaurant Chain to Open 10K-SF Eatery at 365 West 46th Street
items.summary: One thing New York City does not lack is a place to find great Chinese food, and New Yorkers are about to get another spot to add to their lists. Nong Geng Ji , one of China’s most popular Hunan cuisine brands, has inked a 9,900-square-foot retail lease at 365 West 46th Street in Manhattan’s Hell’s Kitchen neighborhood along the famed Restaurant Row, according to tenant broker Meridian Capital Group . The three-level space will be the brand’s flagship New York City location.…

items.headline: Retail Vacancy Falls to 4.3% as Q3 Absorption Hits 10.5M SF
items.summary: National retail vacancy fell 10 basis points to 4.3% in Q3, while shopping center vacancy slipped to 5.4% and mall vacancy dropped 30 basis points to 8.2%. Leasing totaled 38.4M SF and net absorption hit 10.5M SF, led by general retail at 5.4M SF, with shopping centers at 3.0M SF and malls at 1.9M SF. Elevated construction and financing costs keep supply tight, with 58.1M SF under construction, and Colliers expects limited development to support measured rent growth through 2026.…

items.headline: TJ Maxx Signs 29K-SF Deal to Replace H&M at 150 East 86th Street
items.summary: Discount department store T.J. Maxx is replacing H&M in a busy retail spread on Manhattan’s Upper East Side, Commercial Observer has learned. T.J. Maxx has signed a lease for 28,837 square feet at Extell Development ’s retail condominium unit at 150 East 86th Street , according to a source close to the deal and a third-quarter Manhattan retail report from CBRE .…

items.headline: Record Diesel Prices Squeeze Retail Development Pipeline
items.summary: Diesel averaged $6.38 per gallon on Sept. 28, up from about $3.81 in late February, adding to construction and supply-chain costs for retail developers and retailers. Just over 60M SF of retail is under construction, 4% above the all-time low CoStar has recorded, while JLL put Q2 vacancy at 4.4% and net absorption at 10.2M SF. Retailers such as Aldi, Burlington, TJ Maxx and Dollar Tree plan large store expansions, but flat rents and rising costs mean limited new supply to absorb them.…

items.headline: Arlington Redevelopment Gains Steam Near DFW Sports Hub
items.summary: Trademark Property started construction this summer on the $135M-plus rebuild of Lincoln Square into Anthem, a 404K SF walkable retail and entertainment center with 10 tenants signed and completion expected in early 2028. Fairbourne and AEW are modernizing the 747K SF Arlington Highlands, which only recently slipped below 96% leased, while opportunity zones along Collins Street target the gap between downtown and the stadiums.…

items.headline: Bath & Body Works to Open 9K-SF Store in Flatiron District
items.summary: Bath & Body Works is opening a new store in Manhattan’s Flatiron District. The soap and scented lotion purveyor has signed a lease to take over the entire nearly 9,000-square-foot retail portion of 129 Fifth Avenue , according to a source with knowledge of the deal. Bath & Body Works will move into the two-level retail unit, owned by Acadia Realty Trust , in the fall of 2027, according to Crain’s New York Business , which first reported the lease.…

items.headline: Manhattan Retail Availability Hits Record Low as Banks Expand
items.summary: Average availability across Manhattan’s prime retail corridors dropped to 11.4% in Q3 2026, the lowest reading since JLL began tracking in 2017, with only 157 spaces left. Bank of America, OceanFirst and Citibank signed leases totaling nearly 35,000 square feet, and JLL says many more bank deals are pending, adding fresh competition for storefronts.…

items.headline: Eyewear Brand Gentle Monster Takes 29K SF at Kushner’s Puck Building
items.summary: A luxury eyewear brand has its sights set on one of SoHo’s most high-profile retail vacancies. South Korean eyewear brand Gentle Monster has inked a 28,500-square-foot deal at the Kushner Companies ’ Puck Building , Commercial Observer has learned. The lease term is more than 10 years, according to a source with knowledge of the deal.…

items.headline: Miami Retail Pipeline Hits 1.3M SF, Highest Since Early 2023
items.summary: Miami-Dade’s retail pipeline reached 1.3M SF in the third quarter, double last year’s level, as developers gain confidence in a market with 3% direct vacancy. Leasing slowed to 257K SF across 118 deals from 413K SF across 150 deals in Q2, and absorption turned negative, yet triple-net asking rents set a record $44.34 per SF. Heavy preleasing is letting developers underwrite new projects, but vacancy below 3% in core submarkets means tenants must stay flexible to find space.…

items.headline: Charter School Inks 56K-SF Lease in Retail Center Near Miami Suburb
items.summary: Charter school network BridgePrep Academy will open another location, this time inside a shopping center in Miami-Dade County. The school operator, which has 19 locations across Florida, signed a 56,000-square-foot lease at the open-air California Club Shopping Center in Ives Estates, near Aventura, 15 miles north of Downtown Miami. The 273,050-square-foot property, owned by RK Centers , sits west of Interstate 95 at 750 Ives Dairy Road .…

items.headline: Luxury Spending Falls 6%, Raising Risks for High-End Retail
items.summary: Citi says U.S. luxury credit card spending fell 6% year over year in September, after 4% declines in both July and August, challenging a source of strength for luxury retail. Higher earners drive demand: Moody’s Analytics found households earning about $250,000 or more account for 49.7% of consumer spending, up from roughly 36% three decades earlier. The data does not show falling rents or occupancy yet, but landlords with luxury tenants have reason to watch tenant performance as consumer confidence weakens.…

items.headline: Three Fashion Tenants Ink Deals at 231 West 39th Street
items.summary: Three women’s apparel brands have taken office and showroom space at 231 West 39th Street in Manhattan’s Garment District, landlord broker and building manager Adams & Company announced Wednesday. Rino & Pelle , a Netherlands-based women’s fashion and accessories brand, has inked a 3,332-square-foot lease at the 12-story building, while luxury women’s wear and fine jewelry brand Valentina Kova took 1,594 square feet, and ready-to-wear resort attire retailer Sister NY scooped up 900 square feet at the…

items.headline: PNC Lends $96M for Hawaii Retail Portfolio Acquisition
items.summary: Aloha to permanent financing. 11North Partners has landed $96 million of acquisition debt for the purchase of a two-asset grocery-anchored retail portfolio in Lahaina, Hawaii, on the island of Maui. PNC Bank supplied the fixed-rate loan to facilitate the $155 million acquisition of the adjacent Lahaina Cannery and Lahaina Gateway properties from an affiliate of U.S. Realty Partners , according to Northmarq , which arranged the deal.…

items.headline: Italian Restaurant Casa Serra to Open at 227 Front Street in South Street Seaport
items.summary: Lower Manhattan’s South Street Seaport will be living la dolce vita with its latest restaurant lease. Casa Serra , a sister restaurant to East Village eatery House of Pasta , has inked a 2,824-square-foot lease at the Durst Organization ’s 227 Front Street , the landlord announced Tuesday. The 15-year lease has an asking rent of $100 per square foot.…

items.headline: Yves Saint Laurent to Open Store at Kering’s 717 Fifth Avenue
items.summary: Luxury French fashion house Yves Saint Laurent will open a new store at 717 Fifth Avenue , a new report revealed. Saint Laurent is currently at 3 East 57th Street , where it opened in 2003.…
